newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty ends weaker vs basket, some foreigners exit.
newsitem.headline: Zloty ends weaker vs basket, some foreigners exit.

text.p: 1235 GMT - The zloty ended at 0.77/0.64 pct above the trading band centre, weaker than Friday's close at 1.08/0.97 pct as small foreign investor withdrawal from Polish paper was accompanied by larger speculative currency purchases. * It closed at 3.2850/90 to the dollar, down from 3.2595/45 on Monday and at 1.8835/60 to the mark, just up from 1.8850/60. * O/N end at 22.80/23.65 pct slip vs opening's 24.15/24.60 pct and T/N down to 22.50/23.25 vs 23.45/24.65 pct. * Investors bid for 755 million zlotys at 1.1 bln primary tender. * Food prices slip 1.6 pct June 11-20 after 4.6 pct rise in June 1-10. Fruit and vegatables down 9.4 pct after 35.5 jump.
